title: Random Skill Selection: Balancing Weights and New Player Safeguards
subtitle: A deep dive into Roguelike random skill selection mechanics, detailing skill pool structures and weighting algorithms. Learn how synergistic weighting balances diversity while new player safeguards prevent numerical collapse, effectively resolving choice anxiety and optimizing combat generation.

breakdown.title: Basic Structure of the Skill Pool
bullets: Skill Tiering: Core (builds the skeleton) / Enhancement (numerical boosts) / Utility (movement, penetration, control)
Prerequisites and Exclusivity: Certain skills require acquiring A first; others cannot appear together
Duplication Strategy: Upgrade the same skill or swap within a family to avoid drawing useless duplicates

breakdown.title: How to Write Weights That Feel 'Understood'
bullets: Base weights are the 'archetype strength' baseline; do not make strong archetypes appear more frequently
Synergistic Weighting: Increase probability for options that immediately strengthen based on player's current skill tags
Anti-Synergy: Reduce probability for overpowered combinations, but balance this naturally using 'risk/cost' mechanics

breakdown.title: New Player Safeguards (Not Just Hand-Holding)
bullets: First 2~3 picks must include one utility piece (movement, clear, or survival)
Trigger a guaranteed pool after N consecutive misses on core pieces
Place 'trap skills' in late game or reframe them as high-uplimit mechanics with clear explanations
